findings.title: Loop reports omit usage from earlier rounds
findings.description: When a loop repeats, the executor retains earlier rounds in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, but state persistence serializes only `step_result.action_results`. `sq stats run` then reads only the persisted actions, so spend from earlier loop rounds is missing from the rows and totals. Persist the prior-round action results too, or otherwise include them in the report.

findings.title: Fan-out branch usage is lost from run reports
findings.description: Usage is collected for fan-out branches, but the run report reads only each step’s top-level `action_results`. The fan-in reducers produce a single `fan_out` result and do not preserve branch usage metadata; `fan_out` is also not in `LLM_ACTION_TYPES`. Consequently, branch usage is absent from rows, totals, and the unrecorded count. Preserve branch records through fan-in and include them in reporting.

findings.title: Split reviews report only the first part’s usage
findings.description: Each review part is stamped with its own usage record, but the multi-part path folds those results into one action result. `fold_review_parts` retains the first part’s metadata rather than aggregating usage, so spend for subsequent parts is omitted from the persisted action and run totals. Aggregate the part records when folding.

findings.title: JSON review artifacts are excluded from the reviews report
findings.description: The report scans only `*.md`, but review persistence can save standalone reviews as `.json` files. Those reviews are silently absent from `sq stats reviews` and its totals. Include supported JSON artifacts or make the Markdown-only limitation explicit in the command contract.

findings.title: Malformed cost basis can abort the entire reviews report
findings.description: `costBasis` is parsed from YAML as an arbitrary object. If it is a list or mapping, the set-membership check raises `TypeError` because the value is unhashable; the report’s malformed-field handling does not catch it. Validate that the value is a string before checking known basis values, and keep the row with an unknown basis.

findings.title: Compact actions drop usage on prompt-only and failed calls
findings.description: The SDK compact path records usage only after a successful call; its exception handler returns a failed result without using telemetry attached to a `ProviderError`. The prompt-only path also runs `claude_agent_sdk.query()` without requiring a capture or recording usage. Since compact calls are included among LLM actions in the stats report, these paths leave their spend unrecorded. Record available telemetry on failures and capture usage on the prompt-only path.
